critical_code_review_comments: StatusConfigPage.jsx still has availableMenuTypes in its context consumption (from MenuContext) — no functional issue since the UI picker was removed, but stale code comment in MenuContext line 115-124 still mentions 'Used by StatusConfigPage to render the Active Menu selector' which is outdated documentation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: BUG-463 REVISED fix is verified and working. (1) localStorage mygenie_active_menu_type is NOT written on login for both accounts. (2) cafe103 shows All (396) and palmhouse shows All (312) in Order Entry — no 'All (0)' bug. (3) Local Settings has no Active Menu picker. (4) activeMenuPrefs.js is 4 lines only. (5) MenuContext derives activeMenuType from products via useMemo.
